title: Adoption and Entry into force of PIC/S Recommendation (PI 058-1) - Interpretation of the most important changes in the Annex 1 on the Manufacture of Sterile Products (2022)
ai_summary: PIC/S가 2026-10-28 Annex 1(무균의약품 제조, 2022) 주요 변경 해석 권고문 PI 058-1을 채택·발행했으며, 본문은 PI 058-1이 2026-10-28에 발효한다고 밝힌다. 문서는 PIC/S-EMA-WHO 합동 이행 작업반이 작성했고 연결 페이지 범위만 확인했으며 PI 058-1 본문은 읽지 않았다.
source_summary: Geneva, 28 October 2026 PIC/S has published the Recommendation PI 058-1 - Interpretation of the most important changes in the Annex 1 on the Manufacture of Sterile Products (2022). This document was prepared by a sub-group of experts from the PIC/S-EMA-WHO Joint Implementation Working Group (A1IWG) bringing together experts from WHO, EMA, and PIC/S Participating Authorities. The A1IWG was established in January 2024 following the entry into force on 25 August 2023 of the revised Annex 1 on “sterile manufacturing of the PIC/S GMP Guide”. The document, formally adopted by PIC/S, EMA and WHO, was presented to selected Stakeholders during a Briefing Meeting (Webinar) hosted by the EMA on 22 October 2026. PI 058-1 enters into force on 28 October 2026. To download PI 058-1, please consult the page “Publication”
